competitions._source: LND Dipartimento Interregionale C.U. n. 1 of 06/08/2026 (the regulation): every Serie D club (162); a preliminary round of 34 ties (art. 1: the 36 promoted, the 8 relegated from Serie C, the 17 play-out winners and clubs safe by more than 8 points, the 6 re-admitted, the worst of the Coppa Disciplina), a first round of the 34 winners and the 94 others (art. 2), then the main bracket of 64 (art. 3), the last 32 / 16 / 8 paired by the Dipartimento (art. 4); hosts drawn up to the round of 64 (art. 9), from the last 32 alternation (art. 4: the club away in its previous tie hosts; both home or both away: drawn); single matches straight to penalties (art. 5); semi-finals drawn, two legs, points then goals, then penalties directly (art. 6-7); the final two legs until the LND decides (art. 8: two legs or one neutral match; Davide 09/11, Q3). Later seasons (Davide 09/11): the preliminary = the clubs new to Serie D (promoted, relegated from C, re-admitted = the engine's fill-ins, Q2), then the others from the bottom of last season's tables up (the play-out survivors; the Coppa Disciplina place to the next of them, Q2) -- the Mod's entry order; the pairs drawn within geographic blocks (the pool halved by geography: blocks of 2 in the preliminary, 4 in round 1 -- calibrated on 2026-27: 2740 / 3977 km in all against the real 2610 / 4048), the bracket above them fixed. Season 1: the real draw and results (Transfermarkt ITC4, the data session's coppa_italia_serie_d_2627.json); the ties TM leaves out of the last 32 / 16 from the unused winners in order.
